Weight loss isn’t just about eating less it’s about fueling your body enough to support consistency, hormones, and overall health. Whether or not you have this one characteristic will make or break your success on a significant weightloss journey.

1. Eating too little — Your body needs enough food and energy to function properly. 2. Expecting overnight results — Healthy progress takes time, so be patient with yourself. 3. Ignoring your daily steps — Using a walking app can help you track your steps, stay motivated and work towards your daily movement goals! (I use Fastwalk) 4. Not drinking enough water — Keep a water bottle nearby and drink regularly throughout the day. 5. Doing workouts you hate — Find activities you genuinely enjoy so it’s easier to stay consistent. 6. Comparing your progress to others — Everyone’s body and journey are different, so focus on yourself. 7. Being too hard on yourself — Remember, consistency matters more than perfection. Give yourself grace! 💗 #gymtok #weightlosstips #glowuptips #motivation

The best advice I could say is stop putting so much pressure on yourself. If you mess up, start the next day like it never happened. If you get off track, just get back on track. I’ve done so many diets through the years and I have lost but it was difficult. Once I accepted that times going to pass anyways and if it’s a slow loss, so be it, just do your best…it was like a lightbulb switched on and I started to look at life and food different. Food noise is gone, and I just do my best everyday. #weightlossjourney #weightlossmotivation #weightloss
